name: Nam H. Le
affiliation: Morphology, Evolution & Cognition Laboratory, University of Vermont
thesis: I study phase transitions in complex adaptive systems — in living matter, and in markets.
blurb: Evolutionary computation, artificial life, and the language-driven control of living and embodied systems. The same question runs through everything I build: how does coherent, adaptive behaviour arise from parts that have no plan — and once it has arisen, can we steer it?
